name: Piotr Wójcik
detail: The 2020 column favours property and income reform first and postpones a general wealth tax; do not treat its report of Razem's proposal as his endorsement.

name: Ludwik Kotecki
detail: The examined money.pl column describes his proposed wealth tax as a cadastral property tax; obtain his original interview before attributing net-wealth-tax support.

name: Grzegorz Grochowski
detail: IBL PAN literary scholar, died 2022-08-28; Regeneracja roster223. Not the basketball or opera namesake.

name: Ewa Bobrowska
detail: UJ sociologist, died 2021-08-09; Regeneracja roster424. Different from the living ASP artist.

name: Jędrzej Krakowski
detail: Economist, died 2022-11-30; Regeneracja roster459.

name: Arkadiusz Pacholski
detail: Public writer and Kalisz activist, died 2021-01-11; Regeneracja roster137.

name: Łukasz Krzempek
detail: Source-specific hold: bylined11July2025 GRAPE/DGP research explainer discusses wealth taxation but does not clearly recommend enactment. Imperative headline alone insufficient; independent QA agrees.

name: Polish Presidency of the Council of the European Union (2025)
detail: Source-specific hold: Presidency progress report10045/25 explores possible own resources; no adoption or attributable endorsement of wealth taxation.

name: Jan Śpiewak
detail: Advocates progressive cadastral property tax on 3rd+ residential apartments; out of net-wealth-tax definition.

name: Jan Mencwel
detail: Warsaw city councillor; proposes municipal vacancy levies and progressive cadastral property taxation on multiple dwellings; out of definition.

name: Marta Stożek
detail: Sitting Sejm MP (term 10; Koło Razem); assumed seat June 2024 after Interpelacja 2117. All 50 term-10 interpellations and campaign platform reviewed; no personal attributable net-wealth statement found.

name: Aleksandra Owca
detail: Kraków city councillor and Partia Razem national co-chair; sponsored municipal resolution raising property tax rates on vacant speculative dwellings; no personal net-wealth tax statement.

name: Piotr Szumlewicz
detail: Prominent trade unionist and commentator (Związkowa Alternatywa); proposals focus on high progressive PIT and rental property taxes rather than a comprehensive net-wealth-tax proposal.

name: Klaudia Jachira
detail: Sitting Koalicja Obywatelska MP (Zieloni); holds pro-market positions on property and housing, actively opposing broad property and wealth taxation.

name: Urszula Zielińska
detail: Sitting Koalicja Obywatelska MP and Zieloni co-chair; tax proposals focus on environmental taxes (ETS2, emissions) and windfall profit levies on energy firms, not net wealth taxes.

name: Krzysztof Śmiszek
detail: Sitting Polish MEP (Lewica / S&D); distanced himself from property/cadastral taxation and focused solely on vacant property levies; no net-wealth-tax proposal.

name: Piotr Wójcik
detail: Economic journalist and author (Krytyka Polityczna). In articles such as 'Jak zabrać bogatym i dlaczego trzeba' (Jan 2020) and the Spięcie debates, advocates for real estate cadastral taxes on luxury homes, PIT progression, and luxury vehicle taxes rather than a net wealth tax.

name: Ludwik Kotecki
detail: Economist, Member of Monetary Policy Council (RPP), former Deputy Finance Minister. Suggested in media interviews (Rzeczpospolita, Dec 2025) that Poland is wealthy enough to consider a wealth tax ('jesteśmy już na tyle bogatym społeczeństwem, aby rozważyć jakąś formę podatku majątkowego'), but explicitly defined his proposal as reforming and increasing the real estate property tax (podatek od nieruchomości).

name: Wojciech Konieczny
detail: Sitting Senator, leader of Polska Partia Socjalistyczna (PPS), Secretary of State in the Ministry of Health. Policy advocacy centers on universal health tax reform (broadening PIT/CIT base to fund healthcare) and corporate/speculation taxes; no net wealth tax proposal.

name: Paweł Musiałek
detail: President of Klub Jagielloński. In the 2021 Spięcie debates and Klub Jagielloński policy papers, explicitly argues against wealth taxes and anti-capital rhetoric, advocating system simplification and a targeted 'Sprawiedliwa Danina Mieszkaniowa' over net wealth or general cadastral taxes.

name: Jakub Majmurek
detail: Journalist and cultural/political commentator at Krytyka Polityczna. Analyzes domestic left strategy and US wealth tax proposals (e.g. California Prop 40) from an observer/commentary stance rather than articulating an explicit personal policy endorsement for Poland.

name: Adrian Zandberg
detail: Co-signed Sejm interpellation no. 2117 (18 March 2024) to the Finance Minister, which is about the VAT rate on food and mentions only in one sentence that the state should rely more on taxes on capital, owned property and high incomes; that is not a wealth-tax statement. Look for the Razem wealth-tax bill or the MP's own statement.
